blurb: Wild Heart Yoga offers yoga teacher training programs including 200-hour and 300-hour certifications, memberships for unlimited or limited yoga classes, private yoga and sound bath sessions, and event rental spaces. Trainings include philosophy, asana, meditation, and advanced topics. Private classes can be on-site or off-site and customized with add-ons.
